coding.question: How do you implement "Stream queue with a pending buffer" identically in both languages?
coding.explanation: Serve pending characters first, then pull fixed-size chunks through Stream.read from the current stream, advancing to the next stream on an empty read and stashing any surplus.
coding.rationale: Target complexity O(n) per read amortized/O(chunk) buffer. Chunk size trades call count against buffer size.
